design_condition: The building is pushed into the southern green space, extends the schoolyard access axis, and creates a passage linking the schoolyard with the southern path network.

positive.statement: The project achieves its high design goals with precisely formulated proportions.

position.rationale: Layered stepped massing is visible across the top and elevation views.

positive.statement: It enters into dialogue with the existing buildings without losing its independence or disrupting the desired ensemble.

position.rationale: The independent building volume is visible, while dialogue with existing buildings is not represented.

positive.statement: The design towards the schoolyard is good and sensitively developed.

position.rationale: The southern edge is used as the schoolyard-facing facade according to the stated site condition.

positive.statement: The primary-school and textile-design rooms are spatially well organized and benefit from the spacious terrace.

position.target: primary-school and textile-design rooms with spacious terrace
position.rationale: Interior rooms are not distinguishable; the approximate southern lower-volume zone anchors the terrace-related judgment.

negative.statement: The vertical sun-protection slats towards the south seem strange and contrast with the otherwise appropriate design.

position.rationale: The south elevation provides directional facade evidence, though individual slats are not separable.

negative.statement: The nested building envelope is relatively extensive, burdening the grey-energy balance and only barely meeting the stated requirements.

position.rationale: Nested stepped layers are visible in the footprint and all elevations; energy burden itself is non-spatial.

negative.statement: The rigid geometric concept of the themed gardens raises questions about its appropriateness.

position.rationale: The gardens are absent from the sampled envelope; the southern ground edge provides the closest site anchor.

negative.statement: The new north-south axis appears very dominant, while the bicycle-parking arrangement is incomprehensible.

position.rationale: The access-axis critique is anchored to the central plan alignment; bicycle parking is not separately visible.

negative.statement: The strict design of the school garden does not seem child-friendly.

position.rationale: The garden is not directly represented; a southern ground-level site position follows the stated green-space condition.

negative.statement: The desired division into different day-school areas is only unclearly visible.

position.rationale: Interior zoning is indistinguishable, so the lower southern volume provides a constrained approximate anchor.

negative.statement: The access situation for the underground technical-design rooms is unclear.

position.rationale: Underground access is not visible; the low southern edge offers a plausible constrained entry location.

negative.statement: The decision not to orient entrances towards the schoolyard is surprising, while the south facade is unwelcoming and undifferentiated.

position.rationale: The south facade is clearly located, while entrance orientation remains unresolved in the sampled geometry.
